message.text: Dotted children of node_modules are walked as plain trees with no manifest keyed, though Node resolves them.

explanation.what: Dotted children of node_modules are walked as plain trees with no manifest keyed, though Node resolves them.
explanation.whatToDo: Key manifests for dotted slots, or mark them unidentified.
explanation.whyHere: Digest and identified stay unchanged when their package.json changes, so runs are reused across different code.

properties.failureScenario: Scratch install with node_modules/a and node_modules/.foo/package.json {main:"x.js"}, then {main:"y.js"}. Install.read gives the same digest 313dd0bc... and identified true both times, so cached results are reused for different resolved code. canonicalJson was stood in with JSON.stringify.
